parastan karnanErapeksyena sukatukatatrtvahetuna vEsanyanErkrnye prasatya tapyan tatanyasyEva nahatatisarvakartrtvasya nirakaranankikarat yuktivirotana sarvakartrtvan tusayitva prananapavena tusayitunaha– karnanapeksayeti sarvapranikatasukatukakartrtve cetyarta cyoti-stonativakyanaprananan sukatyasatanasyapi punyate tatsatanatvapitayitvatiti prayokat cyotistonativakyaprananyan syat tatasca ‘visno sarvakartrtvapitayako veta aprananan vetatvat cyotistonativakyavat’ iti prayokasanpavena prananapavat na visno sarvakartrtvaniti pava
s: अभिनवचन्द्रिका सृष्ट्यादि करोतीति प्राणिनामिति शेषः आदिशब्देन सुखदुःखादिकं ग्राह्यम् प्राणिनां कर्मसापेक्षः सुरनरतिर्यगादिनीचोच्चयोनिषु सृष्

pk: aBinavacandrika ata evatra visnoriti yadyapyatra purnagunatvan niganayati sutrakara taTapi yuktiviroDapariharena tat sanarTyaniganadevetyarTa purvapaksastu– na visnu sarvagunapurna cetanatvat anyaTa devadatadinanapi taTatvan syaditi sidDantastu– yuktaneva visno sarvagunapurnatvan svatantratvat ‘guna sruta suvirudDasca deve’ iti srutesca tasnadvisno sarvagunapurnatve yuktiviroDaganDaBavat uktan sarvanupapananiti sidDan iti srinatsatyaniDitirTasricaranaraDakasrinatsatyanaTayativiracitayan tatvaprakasikaBinavacandrikayan dvitiyaDyayasya praTana pada
ck: apinavacantrika ata evatra visnoriti yatyapyatra purnakunatvan nikanayati sutrakara tatapi yuktivirotapariharena tat sanartyanikanatevetyarta purvapaksastu– na visnu sarvakunapurna cetanatvat anyata tevatatatinanapi tatatvan syatiti sitantastu– yuktaneva visno sarvakunapurnatvan svatantratvat ‘kuna sruta suvirutasca teve’ iti srutesca tasnatvisno sarvakunapurnatve yuktivirotakantapavat uktan sarvanupapananiti sitan iti srinatsatyanititirtasricaranaratakasrinatsatyanatayativiracitayan tatvaprakasikapinavacantrikayan tvitiyatyayasya pratana pata
s: अभिनवचन्द्रिका अत एवात्र विष्णोरिति यद्यप्यत्र पूर्णगुणत्वं निगमयति सूत्रकारः तथापि युक्तिविरोधपरिहारेण तत् सामर्थ्यनिगमादेवेत्यर्थः पूर्वपक

pk: aBinavacandrika etatpadarTaniti ‘aDyayasyEkarTatvat padaBeda kinibanDana ityata’ iti vartate tasya ‘etatpadarTan darsayati’ ityanena sanbanDa adyaDikaranarTaniti ‘padasyEkarTatva-daDikaranaBeda kin nibanDana ityata’ iti sesa sanKyayogaviti upalaksananetat carvaka ityapi grahyan yadyapi carvaka pratyaksanatraprananyavaditvana hEtuka, taTapi parariti-navalanbya svasastre bahuyuktyupanyasat sopi hEtukesu sangrahya iti boDyan ata eveti asyEva vivaranan harerjagatkaranatve nirisvarasanKyanataviroDapariharaditi prakrtereva nahadadi-karanatvaditi kartrvirahitaya prakrte nahadadikaranatvadityarTa kartrvirahitaya prakrte karanatvan vaktun karanatvanatrasaDakananunanan tavadaha– Bavitavyan Kalviti karyasya svasadrsakaranakatvaniyanepi isvara eva karananastvityata aha– na hiti na ceti prerakatvaniha karyonuKikaranan kevalaprakrtereveti kevalaya prakrte karyonuKatvasya sanayakartrBiraByupaganadityarTa asesakartrtvaditi asesakaryonuKatvadityarTa etena jnanadinatvarupatvadacetanasya kartrtvaBiDananayuktaniti parastan jagatkartriti svata eva karyonuKanityarTa kartr Bavatiti svata karyonuKan BavatityarTa kartEva Kalu svatapravrtinatvat svatakaryonuKa, anyatu upadanadikan prayatnaviDuratvat kartraDinataya karyonuKaniti Bava
ck: apinavacantrika etatpatartaniti ‘atyayasyEkartatvat patapeta kinipantana ityata’ iti vartate tasya ‘etatpatartan tarsayati’ ityanena sanpanta atyatikaranartaniti ‘patasyEkartatva-tatikaranapeta kin nipantana ityata’ iti sesa sankyayokaviti upalaksananetat carvaka ityapi krahyan yatyapi carvaka pratyaksanatraprananyavatitvana hEtuka, tatapi parariti-navalanpya svasastre pahuyuktyupanyasat sopi hEtukesu sankrahya iti potyan ata eveti asyEva vivaranan harercakatkaranatve nirisvarasankyanatavirotapariharatiti prakrtereva nahatati-karanatvatiti kartrvirahitaya prakrte nahatatikaranatvatityarta kartrvirahitaya prakrte karanatvan vaktun karanatvanatrasatakananunanan tavataha– pavitavyan kalviti karyasya svasatrsakaranakatvaniyanepi isvara eva karananastvityata aha– na hiti na ceti prerakatvaniha karyonukikaranan kevalaprakrtereveti kevalaya prakrte karyonukatvasya sanayakartrpirapyupakanatityarta asesakartrtvatiti asesakaryonukatvatityarta etena cnanatinatvarupatvatacetanasya kartrtvapitananayuktaniti parastan cakatkartriti svata eva karyonukanityarta kartr pavatiti svata karyonukan pavatityarta kartEva kalu svatapravrtinatvat svatakaryonuka, anyatu upatanatikan prayatnavituratvat kartratinataya karyonukaniti pava
s: अभिनवचन्द्रिका एतत्पादर्थमिति ‘अध्यायस्यैकार्थत्वात् पादभेदः किंनिबन्धन इत्यत’ इति वर्तते तस्य ‘एतत्पादार्थं दर्शयति’ इत्यनेन सम्बन्धः आद्या

pk: aBinavacandrika aDikaranarTaniti padadO ‘padasyEkarTatvadaDikaranaBeda kin nibanDana’ iti sankotpana sa ca purvaDikaranapratipadyapradarsanena praTanaDikaranavisaye nivrtapi, dvitiya-dyaDikaranavisayenuvartate eveti taneva sankan dvitiyaDikaranavisaye parihartun etadaDikaranarTan darsayatityarTa evanutaratrapi draswavyan karyasataderisvaraDinatvepi isvaronugrahaka eva na karananiti kin na syadityata aha– na hiti asata satasanbanDasyEvotpatitvena karyasataya paranesvaraDinatvanangikrtya karanatvan neti vacanan ‘nata vanDya’ itivadvyahataniti Bava nanvisvarasya jagatkaranatvapratipadananayuktan, ‘brahnEvedan sarvan’ iti tasya jagadatna-katvaBiDanadityata aha– brahnEvedaniti tadaDina sarvasateti hetorbrahnEvedan sarvanityucyate na tu tatadatnyaBiprayeneti Bava ‘sa eva Buyo nijaviryacoditan’ ityadi Basyanasangatan parasparananvayaviDuratvadityasankapariharaya Basyanavatarayati – na kevalaniti na kevalan karyasyesvaraDinatvadityata paran ‘nanugrahakatvanatran’ iti praksiptan ‘isvaraDinatvat’ iti prancani ca praksipta tatascEvan wikavakyapaWa ‘na kevalan karyasyesvaraDinatvan kintu sarvakaranatvenaByupagataprakrtisataderapi tadaDinatvan atasca visnoreva svatantryaniti saprananakan sutraksararTanaha’ iti avasyan cEtadevan vijneyan nanugrahakatvanatranityarTasya udaharisyananaprananadvayena ‘casabdena’ iti Basyena caBavat karyasyesvaraDinatvaditi heto nanugrahakatvanityanenEva ‘kin tu sarvakaranatvenaByupagataprakrtisataderapi tadaDinatvan’ ityanenapyanvayaBavaca asya ‘atasca visnoreva svatantryan’ ityutaragranTenanvayat sutraksararTaniti sutracasabdarTanityarTa atnani atnaDaratveneti ‘ananarupatnani’ ityatratyatnanitisabdasya vyaKyananatnaDaratveneti purvapaksastu – nesvarasya svatantryena kartrtvan yuktan paranesvaranugrhitapraDanadeva parjanyanu-grhitaprTivya ankurotpativat jagadutpatisanBavat ato nesvarasya svatantryena jagatkaranatva-laksanan yuktaniti sidDantastu– yuktaneva visnorjagatkaranatvan svatantryena tatprerananantarena kasyapi vastunoBavat nulakaranaButaya prakrterapi tadaDinasatakatvaca ata sesvarasanKyanatasya-prananikatvenaviroDakatvadyuktan harerjagatkaranatvalaksananiti sidDan
ck: apinavacantrika atikaranartaniti patatO ‘patasyEkartatvatatikaranapeta kin nipantana’ iti sankotpana sa ca purvatikaranapratipatyapratarsanena pratanatikaranavisaye nivrtapi, tvitiya-tyatikaranavisayenuvartate eveti taneva sankan tvitiyatikaranavisaye parihartun etatatikaranartan tarsayatityarta evanutaratrapi trastavyan karyasataterisvaratinatvepi isvaronukrahaka eva na karananiti kin na syatityata aha– na hiti asata satasanpantasyEvotpatitvena karyasataya paranesvaratinatvanankikrtya karanatvan neti vacanan ‘nata vantya’ itivatvyahataniti pava nanvisvarasya cakatkaranatvapratipatananayuktan, ‘prahnEvetan sarvan’ iti tasya cakatatna-katvapitanatityata aha– prahnEvetaniti tatatina sarvasateti hetorprahnEvetan sarvanityucyate na tu tatatatnyapiprayeneti pava ‘sa eva puyo nicaviryacotitan’ ityati pasyanasankatan parasparananvayavituratvatityasankapariharaya pasyanavatarayati – na kevalaniti na kevalan karyasyesvaratinatvatityata paran ‘nanukrahakatvanatran’ iti praksiptan ‘isvaratinatvat’ iti prancani ca praksipta tatascEvan tikavakyapata ‘na kevalan karyasyesvaratinatvan kintu sarvakaranatvenapyupakataprakrtisataterapi tatatinatvan atasca visnoreva svatantryaniti saprananakan sutraksarartanaha’ iti avasyan cEtatevan vicneyan nanukrahakatvanatranityartasya utaharisyananaprananatvayena ‘casaptena’ iti pasyena capavat karyasyesvaratinatvatiti heto nanukrahakatvanityanenEva ‘kin tu sarvakaranatvenapyupakataprakrtisataterapi tatatinatvan’ ityanenapyanvayapavaca asya ‘atasca visnoreva svatantryan’ ityutarakrantenanvayat sutraksarartaniti sutracasaptartanityarta atnani atnataratveneti ‘ananarupatnani’ ityatratyatnanitisaptasya vyakyananatnataratveneti purvapaksastu – nesvarasya svatantryena kartrtvan yuktan paranesvaranukrhitapratanateva parcanyanu-krhitaprtivya ankurotpativat cakatutpatisanpavat ato nesvarasya svatantryena cakatkaranatva-laksanan yuktaniti sitantastu– yuktaneva visnorcakatkaranatvan svatantryena tatprerananantarena kasyapi vastunopavat nulakaranaputaya prakrterapi tatatinasatakatvaca ata sesvarasankyanatasya-prananikatvenavirotakatvatyuktan harercakatkaranatvalaksananiti sitan
s: अभिनवचन्द्रिका अधिकरणार्थमिति पादादौ ‘पादस्यैकार्थत्वादधिकरणभेदः किं निबन्धन’ इति शङ्कोत्पन्ना सा च पूर्वाधिकरणप्रतिपाद्यप्रदर्शनेन प्रथमाधि

pk: aBinavacandrika purvacetanadutaracetanotpatavapi dehe cEtanyotpati kaTanityata aha– kvaciditi vrksantarasya nadirotpadakatvaBavepi vrksavisesasya svaBavatajanakatvavat, Gawadirupacetanesu cEtanyotpadakatvaBavepi deharupacetanasvaBavadeva cEtanyotpatiriti Bava atodrswasyeti atindriyanangikare baDakaBavadadrswan vastveva nasti tatasca kuta isvara, kutastanan tajagatkaranatvan syat na kutopiti isvarasyoktan jagatkaranatvalaksanan na yuktaniti prapte sidDantayat sutranupanyasya vyacaswa ityarTa tatra ‘praswavyan’ ityaraBya aDikaranasanaptiparyantan wikarTosnaBirna jnata iti wika na vyaKyayate purvapaksastu– na yuktan visnorjagatkaranatvan, antarenapisvaran purvasnatpurvasnadutarotarotpati- sanBavat cEtanyotpaterapi nadirotpativat svaBavadevopapate na ca srutyadibaDo vaktun yukta tasyaprananyat na ca tasyaprananye DarnadyasidDiprasanga atindriyavastuno-Baveneswatvat ata isvaraBavanesvarasya jagatkaranatvalaksanan yuktaniti sidDantastu– yuktaneva visnorjagatkaranatvan, carvakasanayasya visayaprayojanadisunyatvena-prananatvena viroDaBavat taTa hi na tavacarvakasanayasyatindriyan visaya tadaBavat napyEndriyikan, tasya pratyaksasidDatvena sastranapeksanat napi svargapavargadisrotrPalan tada-Bavat napi drswan Danadi, tasya krsyadilaGupayasaDyatvat napi pranetu prayojanan pasyana, na ca DarnadyaBavapratipadanadvara lokopakara prayojananiti vacyan DarnaDarnadyaBavajnane parasparahinsadina apakarasyEva prapte napi upakara svata prayojanan, suKaduKavaptiha-nirupatvaBavat na va tenapi kincitsaDyan prayojanan pasyana evanviDe aDikari durotsarita tadaBavadeva sanbanDopi ata carvakasanayasyaprananikatvadyuktan jagatkaranatvan hareriti sidDan
ck: apinavacantrika purvacetanatutaracetanotpatavapi tehe cEtanyotpati katanityata aha– kvacititi vrksantarasya natirotpatakatvapavepi vrksavisesasya svapavatacanakatvavat, katatirupacetanesu cEtanyotpatakatvapavepi teharupacetanasvapavateva cEtanyotpatiriti pava atotrstasyeti atintriyanankikare patakapavatatrstan vastveva nasti tatasca kuta isvara, kutastanan tacakatkaranatvan syat na kutopiti isvarasyoktan cakatkaranatvalaksanan na yuktaniti prapte sitantayat sutranupanyasya vyacasta ityarta tatra ‘prastavyan’ ityarapya atikaranasanaptiparyantan tikartosnapirna cnata iti tika na vyakyayate purvapaksastu– na yuktan visnorcakatkaranatvan, antarenapisvaran purvasnatpurvasnatutarotarotpati- sanpavat cEtanyotpaterapi natirotpativat svapavatevopapate na ca srutyatipato vaktun yukta tasyaprananyat na ca tasyaprananye tarnatyasitiprasanka atintriyavastuno-pavenestatvat ata isvarapavanesvarasya cakatkaranatvalaksanan yuktaniti sitantastu– yuktaneva visnorcakatkaranatvan, carvakasanayasya visayaprayocanatisunyatvena-prananatvena virotapavat tata hi na tavacarvakasanayasyatintriyan visaya tatapavat napyEntriyikan, tasya pratyaksasitatvena sastranapeksanat napi svarkapavarkatisrotrpalan tata-pavat napi trstan tanati, tasya krsyatilakupayasatyatvat napi pranetu prayocanan pasyana, na ca tarnatyapavapratipatanatvara lokopakara prayocananiti vacyan tarnatarnatyapavacnane parasparahinsatina apakarasyEva prapte napi upakara svata prayocanan, sukatukavaptiha-nirupatvapavat na va tenapi kincitsatyan prayocanan pasyana evanvite atikari turotsarita tatapavateva sanpantopi ata carvakasanayasyaprananikatvatyuktan cakatkaranatvan hareriti sitan
s: अभिनवचन्द्रिका पूर्वाचेतनादुत्तराचेतनोत्पत्तावपि देहे चैतन्योत्पत्तिः कथमित्यत आह– क्वचिदिति वृक्षान्तरस्य मदिरोत्पादकत्वाभावेऽपि वृक्षविशेष

cedanarTa-vaditi isvaravEyarTyaditi yastupasarjanatayangikriyate nasavisvara talaksanaBavaditi Bava lOkikapariksakavyavaharo na syaditi lOkikasca te pariksakasceti vigraha yuktavadino lOkika ityarTa etena lOkika pariksaka, na va adye prTagrahananupapati dvitiye na tena purusasyangitvasidDi panaravyavaharenarTasiDdyayogat pariksaka api tirTakarascete kin sanKya utanye nadya tesan vyavaharasya cetanopasarjanasarirasyasnanayanadikartrtvadarsanena purusopasarjanapraDanenEva jagadutpatisanBavat ata isvarasyEvaBavat jagajanadikaranatvalaksanan tasyetyetadurotsaritaniti sidDantastu– yuktaneva harerjagatkaranatvan, purusopasarjanaprakrte jagatkaranatvasaDane drswantaBavat na ca sariraneva drswanta iti vacyan ‘na rte tvatkriyata’ iti srutya sarirapravrtavapi paranatnaDinatvena drswantasya pk: aBinavacandrika praDanadeveti purusena srswyadO kartavye sahakaritaya praDanaByupagananatrenEva srswyade-rupapaterisvaro niyanakatayaByupagantavya iti Bava etena prakrtyupasarjanapurusakartrtvavadina purusasyEva praDanyangikarat praDanadevetyuktirayukteti parastan na ca cetanasyeti purusasahayarTan pravartananasya acetanasya svatapravrtyanupapatiriti na vacyanityarTa purusayukta-syeti svasahayarTan purusa prakrtin niyanayatiti Bava praDanasya sahakaritve uBayo sanapraDanyan syaditi nanyananasya sankananudya nirakaroti – na cangitveti sariropasarjana purusa iti sariropasarjana purusa pravartata iti pakse kevalapurusasya pravrtisaktirasti, na vetyarTa nadya iti Bavenaha – yadyastiti yadi sariran vinapi pravrtisakti syat, tarhi sariravEyarTyan syat pk: aBinavacandrika evaniti utpatO sidDayanityantanavasarasangatisucanarTan nanu praTanikatvadviyadvicara eva kartavya, na tejovicara ityasankapariharaya ‘viyadadinan ca paranatnano janetyatra vivadaBavena’ ityantan vakyan pravrtan atradisabda praksipta viyatascetyeva paWa vayorabaDikarane vicaryananatvat vivadasadBavacadisabdasangrahyaBavat tata paran ‘viyadvicaran parityajya’ iti sesa atra brahnani srutisananvayasidDyarTanityadyantarBavasangatinirupanarTan vayuvicaraparityagena, praTanan tejovicarastu kvacit teja purvasrswe sravanat tatpraDanyavivaksayeti boDyan tadaBavaprasanga iti svatantryena jagatkaranatvaBavaprasanga ityarTa tasya iti uBayakaranatvepi tasya srute aviroDat niravaDaranatvenopapanatvadityarTa sarvan vakyan savaDaranan’ iti nyayena ‘tatejosrjata’ iti srutiravaDaranatatparyavatityata aha – brahnanatreti vrihyaderakaranatvepiti vayvadin vina snaswun sak्yatvepiti Bava vayupraBrtinan devatatvaditi vayupraBrtinan devatatvena ‘vayoragni’ iti srute ninitaparatvasyapi sadBavena viroDasadBavadayasa sarTaka iti Bava ‘upadanasaktesca paranatnaDinatvat’ iti vak्yan praksiptan na wikavakyaniti boDyan purvapaksastu – na srutisananvayena visnorasaDaranyena jagatkaranatvan vacyan tejasa vayujatatve srutisadBavena visnuvat vayorapi agnikaranatvena visnorvisesaBavat na ca vayudvara tejasa paranatnajatatvaBiDayakatvan srutervacyan kin brahna vayudvaranantarena teja sraswuniswe, na va adye dvaravEyarTyan dvitiye tu sanyan tayoravarjaniyan ato na jagatkaranatvena sarvasrutisananvayo yukta iti sidDantastu – yuktaneva tatra sarvasrutisananvayena jagatkaranatvan ‘tatejosrjata’ iti sruteragnervisnujatatvat na ca ‘vayoragni’ ityadisrutiviroDa tatra vayudvara tejaso brahnajatatvokti na ca dvaravEyarTyanupapatya uBayorapi karanatvan vacyan saktasyapi brahnana svecCayEva dvarananusrtya karanatvasya prananasidDatvat ata srutyaviroDena tejaso brahnajatatve sidDe sarvasrutisananvayena jagatkaranatvan hareriti sidDan

ansatvasatanatanansa ityeva purvapaksa karya, tatapi yavan sutranirasyo viparyaya, sa sarvopi purvapaksa iti tarsayitunayan purvapakso tarsita ayan ca ‘sruti anirnayake’ iti viparyaya, srutya ‘ansa’ iti nirnaye krte artanirasto pavati’ iti sutranirasyo pavati vrihiyavasrutyoriva vyavastitavikalpenavirotanasankya nisetati – na ceti vastuvikalpeti pavetatra vikalpa srutitvayoktakriyaya srutyuktasatanayortvayoranyataropatanena svecaya nispatayitun sakyatvat iha tu sitasvarupasya civasya icanusarena ansatvanansatvayorayokena vikalpo na yucyata iti pava patakantaranaha– ansa eveti vyavastitavikalpanasankya nisetati– na ceti ekasyEva sintunatya parapake stitya prahnanyan, tatparapake stitya-prahnanyanitivat, civasya pulokatistityanansatvan svarkatistityansatvaniti tesapetena va, ekasyEva sutyunasya kalapetena stritvapunstvavat, itaninanansatvan kalantarensatvaniti kalapetena va, vyavastito vikalpo pavisyatiti na vaktavyanityarta visesapranananantareneti sutyunatO ‘acaryanukrahatkanan laptva pustvan vyavastaya’ ityati prananasatpavat nirnayo yucyate prakrte tu prananapavana nirnayo yucyata iti pava ata iti asyEva vivaranan srutitvayasyapi nanatvatiti srutyosca nanatvan nana parasparavirutatvaniti potyan ‘ava parena pitaran yo asyanuveta para enavarena kaviyanana ka iha pravoca tevan nana kuto atipracatan’ iti rca purvartan vyacaste – ya paratiti avarasya cakatpitrvetrtvepi cakatpitu tacatatvavyapatesa kuta tevatatasya svacnataputratvavyapatesapavatityata aha – tacnanan ca turlapaniti casapto hisaptarta yasnatacnanan turlapan tasnatacnata iti vyapatisyata ityarta tevatatasya svacnataputratvavyapatesapavepi paranesvarasya sa yucyata eva asata satasanpantavat anapivyaktavyakterapi utpatisaptartatvatiti pava na ca tacnanasya turlapatvanasitan, utararte tatoktatvatiti pavenotarartan vyacaste – ko nu sarvacnakalpa iti ‘striya satistan upe punsa ahu pasyataksanvanavicetatanta kavirya putra sa inaciketa yasta vicanat savituspitasat’ iti rcan vyacaste – ya pakavanurtaya iti rsicnananavasyan sanpataniyaniti pavenaha– etatirkatanovakyaniti srutin caheti sutrarte snrtervaksnananatvat tatviva

pk: aBinavacandrika sanaKyasrutaviti ‘nityayanityaya stOni brahna tatparanan padan srutirvava nitya anitya vava snrtayo yascanya vaca’ iti sanaKyasrutavityarTa visesasrutitvaditi vakyasesabalena vaksabdasya vagindriyarupavisesarTavacitvadityarTa srutan srutyasrayatvaniti srutisidDan nirantaravedocaranasanarTyanityarTa anityasyapi Gawade nityaGawatvadyasrayatvavat, nityasanarTyasrayatvan vaca ‘vagvava nitya’ iti srute vagindriyaparatvepi sayuktikatvepi vaktunavakasa syadityarTa suksnarupavisayeti anaditvapratipadika ‘na hyesotpadyata’ iti sruti vagindriyasya suksnarupavisaya tatasca utpatisrutyanukulyat upacayosti suksnarupenanaditvanastiti kin na syat baDaka-BavadityarTa srutO sruyananan srutyasrayatvan srutyaDikaranatvanatran, na tu sadatanocaranasanarTyan, nuKyarTe baDakaBavat tatasca srutyasrayatvan notpatinatvan virunadvityata aha– srutyasrayatvan naneti nityasarvagatananiti atra naDye sruyananan ‘anyaTa’ iti padan vakyopakrane draswavyan suksnarupena sTitaya api vaca vedocaranasanarTyanastyeveti nEtadbaDakanityata aha– sada vedocaraneti nanapurvarupaniti atra ‘tasnadeva’ iti padadvayanucCinan tatascEvan wikapaWa – tasnananasa eva purvarupan vagutararupaniti nanolaksanakaranavatvasruteriti avasyan cEtadevan vijneyan ‘tasnanana eva’ iti Basyakrtodahrtatvat tatparityagena vakyantaragrahane karanaBavat BasyakrtopasanharasTan vakyanudahrtan wikakrta karyakaranaparatve natayo prananyan Bavati anyonyasrayaprasangat ‘prana sanhita’ ityaderupayogaBavat uktancanyatra BasyakrtEva ‘nana adisabdanan Bagavatparatvan, ‘nanovakpranananasO nanadisu sansTita’ pk: aBinavacandrika nuKyapranaparinanavisayeti nuKyapranadehaparinanavisayasrutiviroDapariharadityarTa vyaptonurveti nahatparinanonuparinano veti sandeha ityarTa saptaskanDagata iti pataladisaptaBunivivaragata ityarTa vyaptasceti pranavayvorekatvat vayudehasya vyaptatvena pranopi vyaptataya srutyocyata iti na tadviroDa ityarTa etena vayorjivatvena jivanutvasya ‘utkrantigatyagatinan’ ityatra saDitatvat tasya vyaptatvakaTananayuktaniti parastan etenEva dehadbahirvartananenetyuktya vyaptyaBavasyarTaduktatvat punarvyaptyaBiDanan virudDaniti parastan dehanahatvasyEva vivaksitatvat purvapaksastu – vyapta evayan prana ‘prana evaDasta’diti vyaptisrute na canutva-srutiviroDa – sakalajagadDarakatvayuktiyuktatvena vyaptisrute prabalyat ata prabalasrutiviroDadaprananan anutvasrutiriti na srutisananvayena harerjagatkaranatvasidDiriti sidDantastu – anureva nuKyaprana ‘sa va esa pranonu’riti srute na ca – vyaptisrutiviroDa tasya bahirdehadvartananavayurupavisayatvat ‘kuta etaditi cet’ ‘antarvanurbahirnahan’ iti visesasrute naqisancaritvayuktesca ata srutyaviroDena nuKyapranasyanutvasidDe yukto jagatkarane brahnani srutisananvaya iti sidDan
ck: apinavacantrika nukyapranaparinanavisayeti nukyapranatehaparinanavisayasrutivirotapariharatityarta vyaptonurveti nahatparinanonuparinano veti santeha ityarta saptaskantakata iti patalatisaptapunivivarakata ityarta vyaptasceti pranavayvorekatvat vayutehasya vyaptatvena pranopi vyaptataya srutyocyata iti na tatvirota ityarta etena vayorcivatvena civanutvasya ‘utkrantikatyakatinan’ ityatra satitatvat tasya vyaptatvakatananayuktaniti parastan etenEva tehatpahirvartananenetyuktya vyaptyapavasyartatuktatvat punarvyaptyapitanan virutaniti parastan tehanahatvasyEva vivaksitatvat purvapaksastu – vyapta evayan prana ‘prana evatasta’titi vyaptisrute na canutva-srutivirota – sakalacakatarakatvayuktiyuktatvena vyaptisrute prapalyat ata prapalasrutivirotataprananan anutvasrutiriti na srutisananvayena harercakatkaranatvasitiriti sitantastu – anureva nukyaprana ‘sa va esa pranonu’riti srute na ca – vyaptisrutivirota tasya pahirtehatvartananavayurupavisayatvat ‘kuta etatiti cet’ ‘antarvanurpahirnahan’ iti visesasrute natisancaritvayuktesca ata srutyavirotena nukyapranasyanutvasite yukto cakatkarane prahnani srutisananvaya iti sitan
s: अभिनवचन्द्रिका मुख्यप्राणपरिमाणविषयेति मुख्यप्राणदेहपरिमाणविषयश्रुतिविरोधपरिहारादित्यर्थः व्याप्तोऽणुर्वेति महत्परिमाणोऽणुपरिमाणो वेति सन्दे

pk: aBinavacandrika sandehabijan srutivigananiti nanu nedan srutiviganan indriyananuBayakaranatvasanBavat yaTa hi devadataya putro devadatasyapi putro Bavati evan indriyani isvarakarananyapi jivakaranani Bavisyanti iti cet, ucyate BavatyevEtacCrutiviganan taTa hi– ‘jivasya karananyahu’ iti srutistavat jivasya karanasvatantryan vakti ‘tadvasaga’ iti tadvasatvaBi-Danat ‘brahnano va etani karanani’ iti srutistu brahnana eva karanasvatantryan vakti etE karayatityaBiDanat na coBayo svatantryan sanBavatiti caksuradiBi karanEriti svasanbanDiBiriti sesa na punarjiveti isvarajnaya jivaprayojyanyapi na jivasanbanDi-nityarTa kuto nendriyani jivasanbanDinityato laGavaya ‘tadanananat’ iti vaktavye ‘jyotiradyaDisWanantviti vadata sutrakrta sucitan yuktinaha– brahnana eveti caksuraderbrahna-prayojyatvasya yaTeswaviniyojyatvasyopapaterbrahnasanbanDini caksuradini na tu jivasanbanDini caksuradinan devatvena yaTeswaviniyoganarhatvat tadeva hi svan nana Bavati, yadyaTeswaviniyogarhaniti Bava
ck: apinavacantrika santehapican srutivikananiti nanu netan srutivikanan intriyananupayakaranatvasanpavat yata hi tevatataya putro tevatatasyapi putro pavati evan intriyani isvarakarananyapi civakaranani pavisyanti iti cet, ucyate pavatyevEtacrutivikanan tata hi– ‘civasya karananyahu’ iti srutistavat civasya karanasvatantryan vakti ‘tatvasaka’ iti tatvasatvapi-tanat ‘prahnano va etani karanani’ iti srutistu prahnana eva karanasvatantryan vakti etE karayatityapitanat na copayo svatantryan sanpavatiti caksuratipi karanEriti svasanpantipiriti sesa na punarciveti isvaracnaya civaprayocyanyapi na civasanpanti-nityarta kuto nentriyani civasanpantinityato lakavaya ‘tatanananat’ iti vaktavye ‘cyotiratyatistanantviti vatata sutrakrta sucitan yuktinaha– prahnana eveti caksuraterprahna-prayocyatvasya yatestaviniyocyatvasyopapaterprahnasanpantini caksuratini na tu civasanpantini caksuratinan tevatvena yatestaviniyokanarhatvat tateva hi svan nana pavati, yatyatestaviniyokarhaniti pava
s: अभिनवचन्द्रिका सन्देहबीजं श्रुतिविगानमिति ननु नेदं श्रुतिविगानम् इन्द्रियाणामुभयकरणत्वसम्भवात् यथा हि देवदत्तायाः पुत्रो देवदत्तस्यापि पुत्र

pk: aBinavacandrika anya srutiriti satyan ‘dvadasa vendriyanyahu’ iti srutidvadasananevendriyatvan vakti, taTapi – na vipratipati dvadasatvasanKyapurakatvasya ‘nanobudDi tu dvadasa’ iti vyasajyavrtitaBiDanena praguktatrayodasanananyatanasyaparityagaditi cet, syadetadevan, ‘yadi nanobudDi tu’ iti srutya dvadasatvan, ‘itihasapuranapancano veda’ ityatra itihasapuranayo pancanatvaniva nanobudDyorvyasajya vartata ityuktan syat na cEvan kinana pratyekan dvadasatvan tatra tatra visrantanucyate ‘dvadase’ iti dvivacanasravanat anyaTa pancana iti vat atrapi ekavacananeva syat taTa ‘nanobudDi’ ityatra sanahara syat tatasca nuKyapranasya parityaga eveti Bavati srutyorviroDa iti caksuradisvapyevaniti parityage baDakanuhyanityarTa uBayordvadasatvanayuktanityato nanasa ekadasatve budDerdvadasitvan, budDerekadasitve nanaso dvadasatvaniti vyavasTaya taduhyaniti Bavenaha– dvadase ekadasadvadase iti ekadasan ca ekadasi ca ekadase ‘napunsakananapunsake’ ityekasesa taTa dvadasan ca dvadasi ca dvadase tata karnaDaraya ekadase ca te dvadase ca ekadasadvadase iti tato nanobudDyo pratyeka-nekadasatvan dvadasatvan ca laByate yadi nanasa ekadasatvaneva budDerdvadasitvaneveti wikasaya syat tarhi ekadasadvadasavityeva bruyat na cEvanuktavan tenokta evasayo boDya etena ekadasadvadasasabdayorvirupatvat srutO ekasesonupapana iti parastan nanobudDyoruBayorapi dvadasatvasyeha vivaksitatve dvadasan ca dvadasi ceti sTite ‘napunsakananapanusakenEkavacasyanyatarasyan’ ityanena ekasesangikarat
ck: apinavacantrika anya srutiriti satyan ‘tvatasa ventriyanyahu’ iti srutitvatasananeventriyatvan vakti, tatapi – na vipratipati tvatasatvasankyapurakatvasya ‘nanoputi tu tvatasa’ iti vyasacyavrtitapitanena prakuktatrayotasanananyatanasyaparityakatiti cet, syatetatevan, ‘yati nanoputi tu’ iti srutya tvatasatvan, ‘itihasapuranapancano veta’ ityatra itihasapuranayo pancanatvaniva nanoputyorvyasacya vartata ityuktan syat na cEvan kinana pratyekan tvatasatvan tatra tatra visrantanucyate ‘tvatase’ iti tvivacanasravanat anyata pancana iti vat atrapi ekavacananeva syat tata ‘nanoputi’ ityatra sanahara syat tatasca nukyapranasya parityaka eveti pavati srutyorvirota iti caksuratisvapyevaniti parityake patakanuhyanityarta upayortvatasatvanayuktanityato nanasa ekatasatve putertvatasitvan, puterekatasitve nanaso tvatasatvaniti vyavastaya tatuhyaniti pavenaha– tvatase ekatasatvatase iti ekatasan ca ekatasi ca ekatase ‘napunsakananapunsake’ ityekasesa tata tvatasan ca tvatasi ca tvatase tata karnataraya ekatase ca te tvatase ca ekatasatvatase iti tato nanoputyo pratyeka-nekatasatvan tvatasatvan ca lapyate yati nanasa ekatasatvaneva putertvatasitvaneveti tikasaya syat tarhi ekatasatvatasavityeva pruyat na cEvanuktavan tenokta evasayo potya etena ekatasatvatasasaptayorvirupatvat srutO ekasesonupapana iti parastan nanoputyorupayorapi tvatasatvasyeha vivaksitatve tvatasan ca tvatasi ceti stite ‘napunsakananapanusakenEkavacasyanyatarasyan’ ityanena ekasesankikarat

adya sruti virancasya nanarupakartrtvan vaktitiheto ‘gOpavanasruti’ ityanantaran virincasya nanarupakartrtvan vaktiti sesa dvitiya sruti visnornanarupakartrtvan vaktitiheto agnivesyasrutirityantaran visnornanarupakartrtvan vaktitisesa iti virincatvayuktiyuktatvaditi virincasabdaBiDeyatvayuktiyuktatvadityarTa yuktiyukta Bavatiti nanu ‘virinca’ iti gOpavanasruti virincasya nanarupakartrtvan vakti pk: aBinavacandrika sarvasabdotra bahusabdaparyaya bahunan gunananayanupasanhartavyo nayanupasanhartavya iti viBaga-nakrtva upasanat bahugunopasanharenopasanaditi yavat anyatra alpagunopasanhartrPaladati-sayitaPale ine brahnadayo, Bavantiti sutrarTa uBayaviDakriyadarsananiti svapeksayalpa-yasasaDyakriyaPalaDikaPalajanakajanakakriyadarsanan sandehabijanityarTa alpaguneti kesancidbahugunopasanhara kinalpagunopasanharakeByo bahugunopasanharakartrnan PalatisayasadBavadangi-kriyate, uta PalaBavepyangikriyata iti Bava nadya iti Palatisayena bahugunopasanhara saDayitun na sakya ityarTa tatra hetunaha– prananaBaveneti PalatisayasyasidDatvana tena lingena tatsaDananiti Bava etena– prananaBavadityanenEva purnatvatPalatisayanirnayaBava-dityaDikaniti parastan svaparicitaprananaBavepi prananantarasanBavat svarupasidDerdatu-nasakyatvena ajnanasidDin vaktun tasya sarTakyat na dvitiya iti nastyeva Palan taTapi bahugunopasanhara kartavya eveti dvitiya pakso na yukta ityarTa nahatvadeveti naha-saDanavatvadevetyarTa purvapaksastu– na bahugunopasanhara kartavya upasanataratanyanusariPalataratanye pranana-Bavaditi sidDantastu– kartavya eva bahugunopasanhara saDanataratanye Palataratanyaniyanat vedoktanahopasanavatanatisayitaPalaBavayogaditi

ck: apinavacantrika kunopasanharanupasanhareti sarvakunopasanharakatipayakunopasanharayo sanartanatityarta upasanharanse prananapavosita ityaksipya nisetati– na ceti vyartaviteriti ista-satanatarupavityarta vituravitipratyayantasyanavateyatvatityarta anupasanharepi noksaprapteruktatvena noksasatanopasanharasya noksasatanatapratipatakavitivak्yasyaprananyaniti pava uktan ca vEpalyaniti upasanharasya vyatirekavyapicarena noksartatvan netyuktanityarta nirartakopasanharartatvan kunapitanasya na sanpavatiti pava anupasanharanse prananapavosita ityasankya nisetati yatapiti upansaharanupasanharayoriti sarvakunopasanharakatipayanatropasanharayorityarta praptesca sanancasaniti nyayeneti atikaripetena upasanharanupasanharavat asya vakyasyatikaripetena anapinatavyavacetapotakatvan anyavyavacetapotakatvan ca yucyata iti pava purvapaksastu– sarvakunopasanharo na kartavya prananapavat na ca ‘upasya eka parata para’ iti palaveyasrutO sarvakunopasanharasya vihitatvat katan prananapava iti vacyan anupasanhari-nanapi caturkunopasakanan noksasya cayananatvat vyapicarinasca satanatvayokena asatanan satanataya pratipatayato vakyasyaprananyat na ca sarvavityanan pakavatkunapitayakatvena tatupasanhara kartavya iti vacyan kunanan nanastanesuktatvena tatapitanasyopasanharartatvapavat, upasanharasya nispalatvena, kunapitanasya tatartatvayokaca napi katipayanatrakunopasanharo yukta prananapavat na ca vacyan prakaranapeta tatra pranananiti tatrEtavatevopasyanityanuktatvat tatasca nopasanan yuktaniti sitantastu– kartavya evopasanhara sarvavityanan pakavananatvena tatkunapitayakatvat tasya ca prayocanantarapavenopasanharapurvakatyanartatvat na copasanharo nispala anantatisaya-laksanapalasatpavat tata virincetarE katipayakunanupasanharena katipayakunopasanhara karya ‘atnetyevopasita’ (pr.) ityatyanupasanharaprananasya vityananatvat atascopasanharanupasanharayo kartavyatvat upasanan yuktaniti sitan

pk: aBinavacandrika isvaraparoksyeti atnatvanatropasanayan siGranaparoksajnanan Bavati caturgunopasane tu vilanbena Bavatiti tadeva sarvopasyaniti Bava Bavetadyaditi vaktityata paran ‘iti syat’ iti sesa satyajnanadivakyavadeveti satyajnanadivakyagatasatyadaya sabda ‘satvan jivananeva ca visirnata ca satvan syat’ ityuktaritya yaTa jivakatva vinasakatvadyanekagunavacaka, taTa atnasabdopyanekagunavacaka iti Bava purvapaksastu– atnatvaneva sarvopasyan nanandadayascatvara ‘atnetyevopasita’ iti savaDaranavacanat itaragunahanena atnatvanatropasanasya susakatvat siGrenesvaraparoksya-sidDigunalaBaca ata atnatvasyEva sarvopasyatvat, ‘anandadaya praDanasya’ ityuktanayukta-niti sidDantastu– anandadayascatvaropyupasya eva atnasabdasya satyadisabdavat ‘atra hyete sarva ekiBavanti’ ityutaravakyabalat bahvarTakatvena anandadyaBiDayakatvat ato viroDaBavat uktan yuktaniti sidDan

karyapraptiriti paksatvayepityarta kranasyeti kesancitkaryapraptireva, na kesancit karyapraptiriti niyanaprayocakasyatikarikatasya kranasya taratanyasyatarsanatityarta krananankikrtyapi karyaparayo praptiriti prakuktan itanin tu astyeva taratanyan, kintu na yokyatarupan aprananikatvat kin tarhi atipalitananravrksan katavato yasyarohanasakti tasya nahapalaprapti yasya narohanasakti tasya kalitapalapraptiriti tarsanat yasya paraprahnapraptO sakti tasya tatprapti yasya tu satyalokaparyantan katasya saktiksaya tasya karyapraptirucyata iti peta nahapala iti nahapale kranasya s: अभिनवचन्द्रिका तेन मार्गेण गतानामिति ननु अर्चिरादिमार्गेण गतानां गम्यनिरूपणादित्ययुक्तम् अप्रतीकालम्बनानामुत्तमेषु लयाधिकारिणां मार्गशून्यत्

pk: aBinavacandrika etatpadarTaniti ‘asyaDyayasyEkarTatvatpadaBeda kin nibanDana ityata Palepya-vantaraBedena padaBeda upapana iti Bavena’ iti vartate tasyanena sanbanDa yastatra Boga iti anuBavarTako BujiDatu, karnani vyutpano visayavaci, Bave vyutpanastu anuBavavaci tatasceha prakarane Bogasabdena yaTayogan kvacidvisayagrahanan, kacidanuBavagrahananiti boDyan arciradyatikranoktiriti srinadBagavate – ‘vEsvanaran yati vihayasa gata susunaya brahnapaTena socisa viDutakalkoTa harerudastatprayati cakran nrpa sEnsunaran’ iti arciradivat sinsunarasyapi hare praptinuktva ‘tadvisvanaBan pratipadya visnoraniyasa virajenatnanEkan nanaskrtan brahnavidanupEti kalpayuso yadvibuDa rananta’ ityatikranokti, ‘sa enan brahna ganayati’ iti ganyatvoktisca, sandehabijanityarTa etenarciradinanatikranokte, brahnano ganyatvoktesca, BinaBinavisayatvena viruDdoktitvaBavat asandehabijatvaniti parastan paranatnanopi arciradyantargatatvenatikranapraptyuktyo ekavisayatvat Binanurtidvayavisayatvena virudDatavijnanat, praksandehahetutvasyavarjaniyatvat aTava arciradivat brahnana apatata ‘etan setun tirtva’ ityatikranokti, ganyatvoktisca, sandehabijanityarTa srutiviroDa iti ‘etan setun tirtva’ iti srutiviroDa ityarTa purvapaksastu nukto brahnatikranya Bogan Bunkte ‘evan tirtva’ iti brahnatikrananantaran svarupavirBavasya uktatvenanatikranya sTitasya svarupanuBavayogat ato nuktasya brahnatikrananiyanana tadganyaniti sidDantastu brahna sanpadyavihayEva Bogan Bunkte ‘sa evan videvan nanvana’ iti srute ‘paranjyotirupasanpadyasvena’ iti srutesca na ca ‘etan setun tirtva’ iti srutiviroDa brahna-praptayenyataranasyEva tadarTatvat ato nuktasya brahnatikranaBavat tadeva ganyaniti sidDan
ck: apinavacantrika etatpatartaniti ‘asyatyayasyEkartatvatpatapeta kin nipantana ityata palepya-vantarapetena patapeta upapana iti pavena’ iti vartate tasyanena sanpanta yastatra poka iti anupavartako pucitatu, karnani vyutpano visayavaci, pave vyutpanastu anupavavaci tatasceha prakarane pokasaptena yatayokan kvacitvisayakrahanan, kacitanupavakrahananiti potyan arciratyatikranoktiriti srinatpakavate – ‘vEsvanaran yati vihayasa kata susunaya prahnapatena socisa vitutakalkota harerutastatprayati cakran nrpa sEnsunaran’ iti arcirativat sinsunarasyapi hare praptinuktva ‘tatvisvanapan pratipatya visnoraniyasa viracenatnanEkan nanaskrtan prahnavitanupEti kalpayuso yatviputa rananta’ ityatikranokti, ‘sa enan prahna kanayati’ iti kanyatvoktisca, santehapicanityarta etenarciratinanatikranokte, prahnano kanyatvoktesca, pinapinavisayatvena virutoktitvapavat asantehapicatvaniti parastan paranatnanopi arciratyantarkatatvenatikranapraptyuktyo ekavisayatvat pinanurtitvayavisayatvena virutatavicnanat, praksantehahetutvasyavarcaniyatvat atava arcirativat prahnana apatata ‘etan setun tirtva’ ityatikranokti, kanyatvoktisca, santehapicanityarta srutivirota iti ‘etan setun tirtva’ iti srutivirota ityarta purvapaksastu nukto prahnatikranya pokan punkte ‘evan tirtva’ iti prahnatikrananantaran svarupavirpavasya uktatvenanatikranya stitasya svarupanupavayokat ato nuktasya prahnatikrananiyanana tatkanyaniti sitantastu prahna sanpatyavihayEva pokan punkte ‘sa evan vitevan nanvana’ iti srute ‘parancyotirupasanpatyasvena’ iti srutesca na ca ‘etan setun tirtva’ iti srutivirota prahna-praptayenyataranasyEva tatartatvat ato nuktasya prahnatikranapavat tateva kanyaniti sitan
s: अभिनवचन्द्रिका एतत्पादार्थमिति ‘अस्याऽध्यायस्यैकार्थत्वात्पादभेदः किं निबन्धन इत्यतः फलेऽप्य-वान्तरभेदेन पादभेद उपपन्न इति भावेन’ इति वर्तते

pk: aBinavacandrika nanu Basye saDakoktavapi krtirahityarupabaDakanudDarat nyunatetyata aha– ata eveti ‘aTa yadenan nuktonupravisati’ iti nuktasyapi spaswan kriyapratite tadviroDat nuktasyakrtinatvan parastaniti Bava iti sanbanDa purvapaksastu ‘sa tatra paryeti’ iti srutyukto na nukta paryetiti kriyapratite nuktasya hi na kriya sanBavati krtakrtyatvat na ca anuktasya evanviDaBogasanBava pragaBavasanBavopi paranatnapraptyanantaran sanBavat na ca srutyuktasyanuktatve ‘svena rupena’ iti vakyaviroDa tatra nirgunopasakasya svarupavirBavaBiDanat ‘sa tatra’ iti daharavidyopasakasyanuktasyEva BogaBiDanat ata srutyuktasyanuktatvat na nuktasya Boga iti sidDantastu ‘sa tatra paryeti’ ityatra nukta evocyate nuktatvan vina etadBogasanBavat svarupavirBavoktesca na ca ekaprakaranatvasanBave Binaprakaranatvakalpana yukta atiprasangat ato yukta eva nuktasya Boga iti sidDan
ck: apinavacantrika nanu pasye satakoktavapi krtirahityarupapatakanutarat nyunatetyata aha– ata eveti ‘ata yatenan nuktonupravisati’ iti nuktasyapi spastan kriyapratite tatvirotat nuktasyakrtinatvan parastaniti pava iti sanpanta purvapaksastu ‘sa tatra paryeti’ iti srutyukto na nukta paryetiti kriyapratite nuktasya hi na kriya sanpavati krtakrtyatvat na ca anuktasya evanvitapokasanpava prakapavasanpavopi paranatnapraptyanantaran sanpavat na ca srutyuktasyanuktatve ‘svena rupena’ iti vakyavirota tatra nirkunopasakasya svarupavirpavapitanat ‘sa tatra’ iti taharavityopasakasyanuktasyEva pokapitanat ata srutyuktasyanuktatvat na nuktasya poka iti sitantastu ‘sa tatra paryeti’ ityatra nukta evocyate nuktatvan vina etatpokasanpavat svarupavirpavoktesca na ca ekaprakaranatvasanpave pinaprakaranatvakalpana yukta atiprasankat ato yukta eva nuktasya poka iti sitan
s: अभिनवचन्द्रिका ननु भाष्ये साधकोक्तावपि कृतिराहित्यरूपबाधकानुद्धारात् न्यूनतेत्यत आह– अत एवेति ‘अथ यदेनं मुक्तोऽनुप्रविशति’ इति मुक्तस्यापि स

pk: aBinavacandrika na visnuriti na visnu, api tu surya ityarTa hetun vaktun sanBavakan tavadaha– jyotisabdasyeti jyotisabdasyaditye prayogo hetutvenokta iti nanyananasya sankananudya niseDati – na ceti pratijnananuvadan tatra hetunaha – atradityangikara iti atra paranjyoti sabdeneti atra yadyapi visayasansayatadbijapurvapaksapradarsananuroDat jyotisabdena paranatnEvocyata iti vaktavyan, taTapi jyotisabdanatrasyanyaganitvepi parasabdavisiswasya jyotisadbasya visnvekanisWatvat atra visnureva vivaksita iti dyotanaya ‘paranjyoti sabdena’ ityuktan purvapaksastu ‘paranjyoti’ iti jyoti sabdokto na visnu kin tu aditya ‘sa tejasi surye sanpano yaTapadodarastvaca vinirnucyata’ iti sanaKyanat evan ca na nuktasya brahnasanipe Boga iti sidDantastu paranjyotisabdena paranatnEvocyate ‘ya atnapahatapapneti paranatnana eva araByaDitatvenasya tatprakaranatvat prakaranarasya sanaKyato balavatvat suryananqala-praptyanantaran papakarnavinasangikarena ‘sa tejasi surye sanpana’ iti vakyasya kinstuGnaprapti-purvakalikasuryapraptiparatvena savakasatvaca paranjyotisabdasya anyatraBavaca ata paranjyoti brahnEveti tatprapya avihayEva nukto Bogan Bunkta iti sidDan
ck: apinavacantrika na visnuriti na visnu, api tu surya ityarta hetun vaktun sanpavakan tavataha– cyotisaptasyeti cyotisaptasyatitye prayoko hetutvenokta iti nanyananasya sankananutya nisetati – na ceti praticnananuvatan tatra hetunaha – atratityankikara iti atra parancyoti sapteneti atra yatyapi visayasansayatatpicapurvapaksapratarsananurotat cyotisaptena paranatnEvocyata iti vaktavyan, tatapi cyotisaptanatrasyanyakanitvepi parasaptavisistasya cyotisatpasya visnvekanistatvat atra visnureva vivaksita iti tyotanaya ‘parancyoti saptena’ ityuktan purvapaksastu ‘parancyoti’ iti cyoti saptokto na visnu kin tu atitya ‘sa tecasi surye sanpano yatapatotarastvaca vinirnucyata’ iti sanakyanat evan ca na nuktasya prahnasanipe poka iti sitantastu parancyotisaptena paranatnEvocyate ‘ya atnapahatapapneti paranatnana eva arapyatitatvenasya tatprakaranatvat prakaranarasya sanakyato palavatvat suryanantala-praptyanantaran papakarnavinasankikarena ‘sa tecasi surye sanpana’ iti vakyasya kinstuknaprapti-purvakalikasuryapraptiparatvena savakasatvaca parancyotisaptasya anyatrapavaca ata parancyoti prahnEveti tatprapya avihayEva nukto pokan punkta iti sitan
s: अभिनवचन्द्रिका न विष्णुरिति न विष्णुः, अपि तु सूर्य इत्यर्थः हेतुं वक्तुं सम्भावकं तावदाह– ज्योतिःशब्दस्येति ज्योतिःशब्दस्याऽऽदित्ये प्रयोगो

pk: aBinavacandrika atra sayujyaBajaniti atra yadyapi sutraBasyaByan nuktanatrasya visayatvan pratiyate, taTapi yasninaDikarane visayatvena yadudahriyate tadeva visaya iti na nantavyan kinana, yavan tanyayagocara sa sarvopi visaya visayadyuktistu udaharananatraniti jnapanaya sayujyaBajanityuktan ata eva ye Boga paranatnana Bujyante ta eva nuktErBujyanta iti sidDante sananyena nuktagrahanan purvapaksastu nukta paranatnaBuktaBoganBunjate avaptanahapurusarTatvat anyaTa kadacit nuktanan BogecCayanapi avaptakanatvena paranatnanastadanicCayan nuktanan Bogo na syat paranatnaBogan vina tesan Bogayogat tatasca BagavadBuktaBogaBoktrtvat yuktan tasya sarvaBoktrtvaniti sidDan (sidDantaBaga nasti)
ck: apinavacantrika atra sayucyapacaniti atra yatyapi sutrapasyapyan nuktanatrasya visayatvan pratiyate, tatapi yasninatikarane visayatvena yatutahriyate tateva visaya iti na nantavyan kinana, yavan tanyayakocara sa sarvopi visaya visayatyuktistu utaharananatraniti cnapanaya sayucyapacanityuktan ata eva ye poka paranatnana pucyante ta eva nuktErpucyanta iti sitante sananyena nuktakrahanan purvapaksastu nukta paranatnapuktapokanpuncate avaptanahapurusartatvat anyata katacit nuktanan pokecayanapi avaptakanatvena paranatnanastatanicayan nuktanan poko na syat paranatnapokan vina tesan pokayokat tatasca pakavatpuktapokapoktrtvat yuktan tasya sarvapoktrtvaniti sitan (sitantapaka nasti)
s: अभिनवचन्द्रिका अत्र सायुज्यभाजामिति अत्र यद्यपि सूत्रभाष्याभ्यां मुक्तमात्रस्य विषयत्वं प्रतीयते, तथापि यस्मिन्नधिकरणे विषयत्वेन यदुदाह्रियत

pk: aBinavacandrika nanu sutrasTa ca sabdavyaKyanat nyunatetyata aha – casabda iti ‘na tesan Bogadisu prayatnapekseti Basyena’ iti sesa purvapaksastu tatadupaya saDyasaDanasaDyo okasi sTitaBogatvat prTivyadyokasi sTita-sansaraBogavat, anyaTa lokaviroDat tatasca sankalpasaDyatvaBavat nukterapurusarTatvaniti sidDantastu sankalpasaDya eva nuktaBoga nopayasaDya ‘sa yadi pitrlokakano Bavati sankalpadevasya pitara sanutisWanti iti srute na ca lokaviroDa nirdose Bagavadokasi taTatvasyEva yuktatvat ato nuktaBogasya sankalpanatrasaDyatvat yuktan nukte purusarTatvaniti sidDan
ck: apinavacantrika nanu sutrasta ca saptavyakyanat nyunatetyata aha – casapta iti ‘na tesan pokatisu prayatnapekseti pasyena’ iti sesa purvapaksastu tatatupaya satyasatanasatyo okasi stitapokatvat prtivyatyokasi stita-sansarapokavat, anyata lokavirotat tatasca sankalpasatyatvapavat nukterapurusartatvaniti sitantastu sankalpasatya eva nuktapoka nopayasatya ‘sa yati pitrlokakano pavati sankalpatevasya pitara sanutistanti iti srute na ca lokavirota nirtose pakavatokasi tatatvasyEva yuktatvat ato nuktapokasya sankalpanatrasatyatvat yuktan nukte purusartatvaniti sitan
s: अभिनवचन्द्रिका ननु सूत्रस्थ च शब्दाऽव्याख्यानात् न्यूनतेत्यत आह – चशब्द इति ‘न तेषां भोगादिषु प्रयत्नापेक्षेति भाष्येण’ इति शेषः पूर्वपक्षस्

pk: aBinavacandrika sOtracasadbarTanaha – casadba iti casabda purvapaksavyavrtyarTan ityarTa tasyEva vivaranan – ‘ananyaDipati’ iti sOtrapadanitiBava etena ata eva cetyanenEva purnatvat ananyaDipatiriti vyarTaniti parastan purvapaksastu nukta svavaraniyanya sarvaDipatisadananiviswatvat rajasadananiviswanatyadivat drsyante hi anatya api rajasadananiviswa nicErapi pratiharErniyanyanana anyaTa lokaviroDa syat ato nuktasyaDananiyanyatvat nukte sansarasananaDarnatvaniti sidDantastu sarvesan paranatnaDipati pranadinanaparyanta deva kranenaDipataya yErjnanan supratisWitan ta acarya api aDipataya natonyo nicoDipatirvidyate satyasankalpatvat loke avaraniyanyatvan hi anapeksitaneva Bavati taca nuktasya satyasankalpatvadeva na yujyate uktan ca ‘paranoDipatistesan visnureva na sansaya’ ityadina ato nuktasyaDanaDipatisunyatvat yuktan nukte sansaravElaksanyaniti sidDan
ck: apinavacantrika sOtracasatpartanaha – casatpa iti casapta purvapaksavyavrtyartan ityarta tasyEva vivaranan – ‘ananyatipati’ iti sOtrapatanitipava etena ata eva cetyanenEva purnatvat ananyatipatiriti vyartaniti parastan purvapaksastu nukta svavaraniyanya sarvatipatisatananivistatvat racasatananivistanatyativat trsyante hi anatya api racasatananivista nicErapi pratiharErniyanyanana anyata lokavirota syat ato nuktasyatananiyanyatvat nukte sansarasananatarnatvaniti sitantastu sarvesan paranatnatipati pranatinanaparyanta teva kranenatipataya yErcnanan supratistitan ta acarya api atipataya natonyo nicotipatirvityate satyasankalpatvat loke avaraniyanyatvan hi anapeksitaneva pavati taca nuktasya satyasankalpatvateva na yucyate uktan ca ‘paranotipatistesan visnureva na sansaya’ ityatina ato nuktasyatanatipatisunyatvat yuktan nukte sansaravElaksanyaniti sitan
s: अभिनवचन्द्रिका सौत्रचशद्बार्थमाह – चशद्ब इति चशब्दः पूर्वपक्षव्यावृत्त्यर्थं इत्यर्थः तस्यैव विवरणम् – ‘अनन्याधिपतिः’ इति सौत्रपदमितिभावः एत

pk: aBinavacandrika yaTa Kalu dvadasaheti atra kraturityahina ucyate ahinatvan ca aharganasaDyakratutvan yaTa ‘dvadasahanrdDikana upeyu’ ityupeyacodane ‘ya evan vidvansa satranupayanti’ iti copeyacodane dvadasahasya satratvan bahukartrkatvat ganyate evan tasyEva dvadasahena ‘prajakanan yajayet’ iti yajati codanena ekakartrkatvat ‘dviratrena yajati’ ityadineva ahinatvan ganyata iti taduBayan dvadasahasyavirudDan taTa nuktasya sasariratvan asariratvan ca prananikatvadavirudDaniti Bava nanu ‘Bave jagradvat’ iti sutrananaranBaniyan sariraBave, BogasanBavasyanapaditatvena tadupapadanavEyarTyadityata aha– vaksyananeti ‘pradipavadavesastaTa hi darsayatiti vaksyananaprastavayetyarTa nanu tatprakasayanta iti vyarTanityata aha – tatprakasayanta iti sutre pradipadrswantagrahanasyapi praya ucyata ityarTa atra gunasutran – ‘svapyaya-sanpatyoranyatarapeksanaviskrtan hiti ‘tirno hi’ iti vakyan suptinoksayoranyatarapeksan anyatarapratipadakan, hi yasnat atra pitapita Bavati’ityaviskrtan’ iti sutrarTa srutestavadarTadvayan ekasyan yojanayan svapyayaparatvan, yojanantare tu sanpatiparatvan ityanyatara-peksatvaniti Bava etena sanpatiparatvasyEva vaktavyatvat anyatarapeksaniti sandigDatvakaTanan ayuktaniti parastan purvapaksastu na nuktanan Bogo yujyate dehaBavaBavayorviroDat taTa hi nuktasya bahyadeho vidyate na va nadya dupraKasangat dvitiye BogasanBava asaririno Bogayogat na ca cicCarirena Bogopapati suptyadO vidyananasyapi tasya Bogayatanatvadarsanat na ca brahnanadehena tadupapati paradehasya paran prati Bogayatanatvayogat ata kaTanapi nuktanan nirduKaBogayogat apurusarTatvan nukteriti sidDantastu yukta eva nuktanan Boga cinatradehasadBavat na ca tasya suptavadarsanat BogayatanatvasanBava ajnanadyavrtatvena tada BogayatanatvaBavepi ajnananivrtyanantaran tatsanBavat tarhi pratibadDan karanan karyan na janayatityetavata tadapaganepi karyan na janayatiti sanpratan na ca duKaprasanga bahyadehaBavat ‘asariran vava santan na priyapriye sprsata’ iti ananaditi badariracaryo nanyate taTa yukta eva nuktanan Boga bahyadehasya sadBavat na ca tatra prananaBava ‘cita va cita va nityena vaTanandiBavati’ iti vikalpananat iti jEniniracaryo nanyate paksadvayepi prananasadBavat nuktanan bahyadeho vidyate na vidyata iti Bagavanbadarayano nanyate na ca sariraBavaBavayorasanBava dvadasahaparisanapyasya yagasya icCaya sariraBavaBavayorupapate na ca sariraBavadasayan BogaBava, sariraBavepi svapnavadupapate nanu sariradasayan jagradvat nuktanan bahyadehena BogoBinata evan ca sati duKanapi prapnatiti
ck: apinavacantrika yata kalu tvatasaheti atra kraturityahina ucyate ahinatvan ca aharkanasatyakratutvan yata ‘tvatasahanrtikana upeyu’ ityupeyacotane ‘ya evan vitvansa satranupayanti’ iti copeyacotane tvatasahasya satratvan pahukartrkatvat kanyate evan tasyEva tvatasahena ‘pracakanan yacayet’ iti yacati cotanena ekakartrkatvat ‘tviratrena yacati’ ityatineva ahinatvan kanyata iti tatupayan tvatasahasyavirutan tata nuktasya sasariratvan asariratvan ca prananikatvatavirutaniti pava nanu ‘pave cakratvat’ iti sutrananaranpaniyan sarirapave, pokasanpavasyanapatitatvena tatupapatanavEyartyatityata aha– vaksyananeti ‘pratipavatavesastata hi tarsayatiti vaksyananaprastavayetyarta nanu tatprakasayanta iti vyartanityata aha – tatprakasayanta iti sutre pratipatrstantakrahanasyapi praya ucyata ityarta atra kunasutran – ‘svapyaya-sanpatyoranyatarapeksanaviskrtan hiti ‘tirno hi’ iti vakyan suptinoksayoranyatarapeksan anyatarapratipatakan, hi yasnat atra pitapita pavati’ityaviskrtan’ iti sutrarta srutestavatartatvayan ekasyan yocanayan svapyayaparatvan, yocanantare tu sanpatiparatvan ityanyatara-peksatvaniti pava etena sanpatiparatvasyEva
